info.title: MetaPOS Agnostic & Odoo 19 Dual Facade POS API
info.description:
Enterprise-grade, platform-agnostic OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification for MetaPOS Point of Sale.
Features a Dual Facade architecture:
1. Clean Agnostic RESTful endpoints (`/api/v1/...`) for any web or mobile frontend (Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Vue/React).
2. Direct Odoo 19.0 Community JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoints (`/web/session/...`, `/web/dataset/call_kw/...`, `/web/image`) for zero-proxy direct client-to-backend communication.

Includes full schemas, authentication workflows, offline synchronization invariants, and Bangladesh NBR Mushak 6.3 retail compliance.

post.description:
Idempotent order submission endpoint. Accepts orders captured locally offline or online.

**CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL INVARIANTS**:
1. **Idempotency**: `uuid` must be an RFC 4122 v4 UUID. Resubmitting an identical UUID returns the existing confirmed order without creating duplicate database rows.
2. **Line UUIDs**: Every line must contain an independent RFC 4122 v4 UUID in `lines[i].uuid`. Odoo 19 enforces a database unique constraint `pos_order_line_unique_uuid`.
3. **Overpayment Change Balancing**:
   - **Pattern A (Client Net Settlement)**: `amount_paid == amount_total`, single payment line of `amount_total`, `amount_return: 0.0`.
   - **Pattern B (Balancing Change Line)**: Gross tender line (e.g. ৳500), paired with balancing negative change line (e.g. ৳-390, `is_change: true, name: 'ফেরত'`), `amount_paid == amount_total`, and top-level `amount_return: 0.0`.
   - **Forbidden**: Sending top-level `amount_return > 0` causes verbatim error `UserError: অর্ডার /-এর মূল্য পুরোপুরি পরিশোধ হয়নি।`.

post.description: Validates session cookie liveness. Returns `SessionExpiredException` (code 100) if cookie is missing or expired.
Terminates the current session on the Odoo server.

Executes any Odoo ORM model method with positional arguments (`args`) and keyword arguments (`kwargs`).
All POS operations (catalog, customers, sessions, stock, sync) invoke this gateway.

**Standard Supported Models & Methods**:
- `pos.config` / `search_read`: Discover registers
- `pos.config` / `open_ui`: Initialize register UI
- `pos.session` / `search_read`: Query active sessions
- `pos.session` / `set_opening_control`: Set register opening cash balance
- `product.product` / `search_read`: Query products and book metadata
- `product.template` / `book_read_qty_on_hand`: High-speed stock count
- `pos.category` / `search_read`: Fetch POS categories
- `res.partner` / `search_read`: Search customers (using `phone` only)
- `res.partner` / `create`: Create customer
- `pos.order` / `sync_from_ui`: Submit order payload batch
- `book.fair.dashboard` / `get_dashboard_data`: Retrieve dashboard KPIs

sessionCookie.description: Odoo session cookie captured from `Set-Cookie` on `/web/session/authenticate`.

bearerAuth.description: Optional bearer token for REST facade API gateways.

list_price.description: Base catalog list price in BDT (৳)

phone.description: Unified phone field. Note that 'mobile' is strictly removed in Odoo 19.

vat.description: Customer Tax BIN for NBR Mushak 6.3 invoices

total_revenue.description: Gross revenue including VAT in BDT (৳)

untaxed_revenue.description: Net revenue before VAT in BDT (৳)

copies_sold.description: Total physical quantity of books sold

session_id.description: Active Odoo POS session ID (e.g. 23). Must point to an opened session.

date_order.description: Timestamp in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format in UTC/BST

amount_paid.description: Net reconciled payment total. Must strictly equal amount_total.

amount_return.description:
**MANDATORY ODOO 19 INVARIANT**: Top-level `amount_return` must be `0.0`.
Overpayment change must be recorded via balancing negative change payment line (`is_change: true, name: 'ফেরত'`).
Passing `amount_return > 0` causes verbatim error: `UserError: অর্ডার /-এর মূল্য পুরোপুরি পরিশোধ হয়নি।`.

uuid.description: RFC 4122 v4 UUID generated on client at transaction creation. Enforces idempotency.

lines.description: Array of Odoo command tuples `[0, 0, OrderLinePayload]` sorted by product_id ascending.

payment_ids.description: Array of Odoo command tuples `[0, 0, PaymentLinePayload]`.

price_unit.description: Net unit price before tax (under reverse-net tax: MRP / 1.10)

tax_ids.description: Odoo command tuple for many2many tax IDs: [[6, 0, [tax_id]]]

uuid.description: Independent RFC 4122 v4 UUID for the line. Must be strictly unique across the database.

name.description: Optional name for payment line (e.g. 'ফেরত' for change lines)

amount.description: Positive tender amount or negative change refund amount

is_change.description: True if this line represents customer change return

message.example: Order is not fully paid or duplicate line UUID detected.

result.description: Return value of the invoked ORM method

code.description:
JSON-RPC error code.
- `200`: Standard Odoo business logic or ORM exception
- `100`: SessionExpiredException (unauthenticated or stale cookie)

message.description: Verbatim exception message (often localized in Bengali bn_IN)
